categories.question: A field recorder comes on at dawn. Which prairie resident do you hope to see?

outcomes.name: American bison
outcomes.description: American bison — large dark bison with a shoulder hump

outcomes.name: Prairie dog
outcomes.description: Prairie dog — tan prairie dog upright on hind legs

outcomes.name: Pronghorn
outcomes.description: Pronghorn — light tan pronghorn with forked black horns

outcomes.name: Black-footed ferret
outcomes.description: Black-footed ferret — pale slender ferret with dark feet and mask

categories.question: Your safari sketchbook opens to a page about horns. Which antelope do you draw?

outcomes.name: Gemsbok
outcomes.description: Gemsbok — grey antelope with straight spear-like horns and black face markings

outcomes.name: Greater kudu
outcomes.description: Greater kudu — grey-brown antelope with huge spiral horns

outcomes.name: Springbok
outcomes.description: Springbok — slim tan antelope with dark side stripe and lyre-shaped horns

outcomes.name: Sable antelope
outcomes.description: Sable antelope — dark antelope with long backward-curving ridged horns

categories.question: The wildlife guide asks you to pick a scavenger for a conservation sign. Which one?

outcomes.name: Spotted hyena
outcomes.description: Spotted hyena — sloping-backed tan hyena with dark spots

outcomes.name: Marabou stork
outcomes.description: Marabou stork — tall black and white stork with bare pink head

outcomes.name: White-backed vulture
outcomes.description: White-backed vulture — large brown vulture with pale neck ruff

outcomes.name: Black-backed jackal
outcomes.description: Black-backed jackal — slender russet jackal with a dark saddle

categories.question: You're restoring a small patch of meadow. Which plant goes on the planting-day flyer?

outcomes.name: Purple prairie clover
outcomes.description: Purple prairie clover — thimble-shaped purple flowering prairie clover

outcomes.name: Little bluestem
outcomes.description: Little bluestem — copper-blue clump of prairie grass

outcomes.name: Goldenrod
outcomes.description: Goldenrod — arching spray of tiny golden yellow blossoms

outcomes.name: Milkweed
